items.text: Kjal, thiolen! Ma staren kjolda dun.
items.respelling: KYAL THYOH-len MAH STAR-en KYOL-dah DOON
items.translation: Drink, brave ones! May the stars keep you.
Free the blade, bound the word.
Beneath the star, no rune shines.

items.text: Thiark aur star ke ne vyrner.
items.respelling: THYARK OWR STAR KEH NEH VÜR-ner
items.translation: Seek a silver star that does not move.

items.text: Thal doler sel, thal hjald dyni heim.
items.ipa: [sal ˈdo.lər sel sal hjald ˈdy.ni hejm]
items.respelling: THAL DOH-ler SEL THAL HYALD DÜ-nee HAYM
items.translation: Where it falls, there raise your home.
Tyr guarded the wall. (I saw it.)
Tyr guarded the wall. (So the songs say.)
Tyr will guard the wall. (It is foretold.)
Tyr guards the wall at night.
At night, Tyr guards the wall.
Hello! (to several people, or politely to one)

items.text: Em es hel, mund. Eth dy?
items.respelling: EM ES HEL MOOND ETH DÜ

items.translation: My name is Astrid, Alkregg's child.
May the stars keep you. (formal farewell, Auristar)
Some ale, please. (lit. may you give me ale)

items.text: Ter dryneth, ter orth, ter heim!
items.respelling: TER DRÜ-neth TER ORTH TER HAYM
items.translation: To friendship, to renown, to home!

items.text: Ma emi bikk nekuna vesa tymm.
items.respelling: MAH EH-mee BIK NEH-koo-nah VEH-sah TÜM
items.translation: May my tankard never be empty.
The cook made stew. (cooks are called 'fire')

items.text: Aulin es kjeldug, eth fyrin es dalg.
items.ipa: [ˈau.lin es ˈcel.dug eð ˈfy.rin es dalg]
items.respelling: OW-lin ES KYEL-doog ETH FÜ-rin ES DALG
items.translation: The ale is cold and the fire is warm.

items.text: Kumik metter yn kamar ter yn nim?
items.ipa: [ˈku.mik ˈmetː.ər yn ˈka.mar ter yn nim]
items.respelling: KOO-mik MET-er ÜN KAH-mar TER ÜN NIM
items.translation: How much is a room for one night?
That's a tavern tale. (a tall story)
Where is the road to Auristar?
Go north, as far as the bridge.

items.text: Snarv ve heg yrvin a kampin.
items.respelling: SNARV VEH HEG ÜR-vin AH KAM-pin

items.text: Kur orker em hytta yn kjalheim?
items.respelling: KOOR OR-ker EM HÜT-ah ÜN KYAL-haym
items.translation: Where can I find an inn?
The road is dangerous at night.
Where does this canal boat go?
Row me to the First Ring! (Starisund)
Three silver pennies, and not less.
You owe me five copper coins.
The prey fled into the forest.
How many monsters have you hunted?
The trophy is mine to take.
The hunt went well, I saw it myself.
For Auristar and the Seven Lights!
I saw it with my own eyes.

items.text: Ma Ur eth Nett vesa emi sajiren.
items.ipa: [ma ur eð netː ˈve.sa ˈe.mi ˈsa.ji.rən]
items.respelling: MAH OOR ETH NET VEH-sah EH-mee SAH-yee-ren
items.translation: May Ur and Nett be my witnesses.

items.text: Sof em lusker, ma emi tynn dola.
items.ipa: [sof em ˈlu.skər ma ˈe.mi tynː ˈdo.la]
items.respelling: SOF EM LOO-sker MAH EH-mee TÜN DOH-lah
items.translation: If I lie, may my teeth fall out.

items.text: Dys bikk es tymm, eth dys skult ok.
items.ipa: [dys bikː es tymː eð dys skult ok]
items.respelling: DÜS BIK ES TÜM ETH DÜS SKOOLT OK
items.translation: Your tankard is empty, and so is your head.

items.text: Dy es sam vond sam kjalskeng.
items.respelling: DÜ ES SAM VOND SAM KYAL-skeng
items.translation: You're as bad as a hangover.
Go to the void! (the worst thing to wish anyone)
How old are you? (lit. how many years do you have?)
From Ur, to Nett. (from the Source to the Firmament: the path of every life)
They have joined the stars. (said of the dead)
May they shine among the stars.
What do the stars say? (asked of a star-reader)
O Light, welcome to our home.
I beg your pardon. (lit. may you forgive me)
O Light, will you guard our home?
O Blade! Thanks for your sword. (to a sworn mercenary)
